content.title: Teddi Mellencamp’s Ex Edwin Arroyave Reveals How He's Supporting Her Amid Stage 4 Cancer Battle
content.text: Despite his ongoing marital split from Teddi Mellencamp, Edwin Arroyave continues to be a strong source of support for his estranged wife. The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills dad shed more light on the dynamic during the January 19 episode of The Eds, nearly one year after Teddi was diagnosed with Stage 4 cancer.How to WatchThe Real Housewives of Beverly Hills Season 15 airs on Thursdays at 8/7c on Bravo and streams next day on on Peacock. Stream on Edwin told his co-host, The Real Housewives of Orange County husband Eddie Judge, that Teddi was pushing through her latest round of immunotherapy, but her limited mobility has taken a heavy toll on her mental state.Edwin Arroyave offers update on Teddi Mellencamp's health journey“One of the hardest things for her is she really can’t work out,” Edwin said. “She's just starting to kind of move her body, but I think that's what's been real tough for her... She's going through the immunotherapy, which, that alone, causes some side effects. So, that's been really hard on her mental health.”RELATED: Teddi Mellencamp Shares New Outlook Amid Cancer Journey: “Near-Death Has That Effect on You”Edwin acknowledged there wasn’t much he could do to alleviate Teddi’s physical discomfort, but he made sure to show his support through words of encouragement. “It's been inspiring to watch what a tough battle that she's happened to go through,” the father of four said. “And, you know, it sucks because you're in a position where there's not much you can do, right? Because there's also what she's feeling on the inside, which nobody really sees. It’s a lot. But the good news is, you know, I got to remind her all the time, 'You got to focus on the positives.'”Edwin Arroyave reflects on Teddi Mellencamp's "miracle" health progressEdwin said Teddi occasionally fails to give herself credit and recognize how she’s defied the odds. In 2022, The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills alum was first diagnosed with Stage 2 melanoma, marking the beginning of a years-long cancer battle. Cut to February 2025, when doctors learned that Teddi’s cancer had metastasized to her brain and lungs. She immediately underwent surgery and radiation to remove multiple tumors, which have since been eliminated.“The good news, though, is that those tumors are gone from what we can see,” Edwin continued. “The chances of that happening were .001 [percent]. So, that was totally a miracle from god.”In October 2025, Teddi announced there was “no detectable cancer” in her body; however, she was not considered in remission, as she had another year of immunotherapy treatments.RELATED: Teddi Mellencamp Reveals There Is "No Detectable Cancer" in Latest Health UpdateAbout three months before doctors discovered Teddi’s tumors, the mother of three revealed she had filed for divorce from Edwin after 13 years of marriage. The exes ultimately put the legal proceedings on pause to focus on their family and Teddi’s health.Kyle Richards on how Teddi Mellencamp's cancer affected their friendshipTeddi’s good friend and former RHOBH castmate Kyle Richards reflected on Teddi’s challenging year in a November 2025 interview with The Daily Dish. “You know, and just going through what she’s gone through, [it] just brought us even closer,” Kyle said. “I mean, what I was going through first, and then what she was going through with her separation, and then having this curveball come at her, like, this was just really mindblowing, you know, to think that someone that you’re so close to and love so much is going through something so scary. It really did just bring us even closer, and I just love and appreciate her so much.”Find out what Teddi’s dad, Rock and Roll Hall of Famer John Cougar Mellencamp, had to say about her difficult health journey.
